name: Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals Co.
source: Yahoo Finance | extended from stockanalysis.com | gap-filled 2026-10-07 from stockanalysis.com EGX income statement | H1 2026 and H1 2025 added 2026-11-22 from Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals (Sidpec) own issued statements: the reviewed interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (sidpec.com PDFHandler ReportID 17, English translation of the Arabic original), cross-checked against the audited FY2025 statements (ReportID 15). Amounts in EGP. H1 2026: net sales 8,534,210,555 less total cost of sales 7,350,737,452 equals the printed gross profit 1,183,473,102 (one EGP rounding in the painted statement). Operating expenses are the printed marketing 138,961,387 plus general and administrative 511,658,213 plus provisions 51,519,091 plus other expenses 43,944,126 = 746,082,817, so gross profit less operating expenses equals EBIT 437,390,285. Net finance costs are finance expenses 88,865,989 less credit interest 163,476,955, a net finance income of 74,610,966 stored negative. PBT 657,870,452 is EBIT plus net finance income plus investment income 113,846,028, other operating income 3,240,179, other income 3,156,622 and foreign exchange gain 25,626,370 (the sum lands 2 EGP above the printed PBT, rounding inside the printed statement). Income tax is the printed tax 171,455,444 less the deferred tax credit 21,190,026 = 150,265,418, so PBT less tax equals the printed net profit 507,605,034 exactly. EPS 0.38 is printed on the face of the profit or loss statement; note 3-27 shows 0.39 on the distributable profit after the legal reserve and board share. H1 2025 from the same statement: net sales 7,551,337,587, cost of sales 6,052,156,536, gross profit 1,499,181,051, operating expenses 412,929,850, EBIT 1,086,251,201, net finance income 40,180,757 stored negative, PBT 1,201,269,898, income tax 173,866,763 net of the 41,014,965 deferred credit, net profit 1,027,403,135, and PBT less tax ties exactly. The profit or loss pages of the issuer PDF are images, so the figures were read by OCR at 300 dpi and cross-checked against the printed totals, the statement of comprehensive income and the statement of financial position. EPS in EGP per share. | The H1 2026 ROE, ROA and debt to equity are period ratios on the 30 June 2026 balance stored in the balance file. The H1 2025 ROE, ROA and debt to equity are left empty because no balance sheet as at 30 June 2025 is printed in either statement held here.
note: Periods and blank series extended from stockanalysis.com (secondary provider, reported figures). A value was accepted only where the provider reproduced the stored figure for the same row in an overlapping year within 1.5 percent; no existing value was changed.
